import sys,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/home/vivi/pixelated')
from scripts.training.v6_policy_resolution import DIRECTORY,OUTPUT,ROOT,rows,write,write_rows
from scripts.training.verify_v6_policy_final import groups,verify_response,write_stage
router=json.loads((DIRECTORY/'calibration-v2/gemma4-calibration-config.json').read_text())['arms'][0]
certificate=json.loads((DIRECTORY/'task-review-v3/certificate.json').read_text())
changes=rows(OUTPUT/'bounded-v15-changed/results.jsonl');new={(r['case_id'],r['arm_id']):r for r in changes}
if len(changes)!=14 or any(r['status']!='success' for r in changes):raise ValueError('changed run incomplete')
proof={'network_calls':0,'clinical_validation':False,'stages':[],'implementation_sha256':{name:hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'ai/training'/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ['contextual_support_policy.py','support_task_review.py']}}
for stage in ['original','confirmation']:
 source=DIRECTORY/'bounded-support-v14'/stage
 cases={c['id']:c for c in rows(source/'cases.jsonl')};config=json.loads((source/'config.json').read_text())
 old=rows(OUTPUT/f'bounded-v14-{stage}/results.jsonl');prov=json.loads((OUTPUT/f'bounded-v14-{stage}/trace-provenance.json').read_text())['rows'];sources={(x['case_id'],x['arm']):ROOT/x['source_results'] for x in prov}
 final=[];audit=[];provenance=[];calls=0
 for row in old:
  key=(row['case_id'],row['arm_id']);selected=new.get(key,row)
  src=OUTPUT/'bounded-v15-changed/results.jsonl' if key in new else sources[key]
  actual=rows(src);index=next(i for i,r in enumerate(actual) if (r['case_id'],r['arm_id'])==key)
  trace=groups(rows(src.parent/'all-provider-calls.jsonl'))[index]
  prefix=src.parent.name.replace('bounded-','bounded-support-',1)
  version,substage=prefix.rsplit('-',1)
  cfg=json.loads((DIRECTORY/version/substage/'config.json').read_text())
  t,count=verify_response(trace,(router,certificate),cfg,cases[key[0]]['messages'],selected)
  final.append(selected);audit.extend(t.audit);calls+=count
  provenance.append({'case_id':key[0],'arm':key[1],'source_results':str(src.relative_to(ROOT)),'source_config_sha256':selected['config_sha256'],'method':'fresh changed-route response' if key in new else 'unchanged real response replayed against current v15 code','matched_provider_calls':count,'response_sha256':hashlib.sha256(selected['response'].encode()).hexdigest()})
 target=DIRECTORY/'bounded-support-v15'/stage;output=OUTPUT/f'bounded-v15-{stage}'
 write_rows(target/'cases.jsonl',list(cases.values()));write(target/'config.json',config)
 write_rows(output/'results.jsonl',final);write_rows(output/'routing-audit.jsonl',audit)
 write(output/'trace-provenance.json',{'derived_no_new_provider_calls':True,'rows':provenance,'method':'Source real row hashes preserved. Costs counted only in underlying provider ledgers.'})
 proof['stages'].append({'stage':stage,'verified_responses':len(final),'matched_provider_calls':calls})
proof.update(passed=True,unchanged_responses_replayed=74,changed_responses_fresh_and_replayed=14)
write(DIRECTORY/'bounded-support-v15/current-code-replay-proof.json',proof);print(proof)
